name: wolf
meaning: The Wolf, found once at init by Scenaric_FindByClass(0). If the search fails it stays NULL and Update falls back to testing the balance's own position, which is inside its own box by construction — the platform would read as permanently pressed.

name: wolfInside
meaning: Latched 'the Wolf is in the trigger box' flag; the animation only changes on a transition (anim 2 pressed, anim 4 released).

name: triggerBox
meaning: World-space trigger volume baked once at init from the model's first NON-solid box plus the object position. The class writes only min (0x70/0x72/0x74) and max (0x76/0x78/0x7a) and never the flags dword at 0x6c; a whole Box here is the only layout that explains the 0x69..0x6f hole (nothing reference
